column3: Vietnam Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg, signed 2026-06-30, in force 2026-08-15, under the Vietnam AI Law in force 2026-03-01: 46 high-risk AI systems across 6 sectors, THREE of them education - (1) automated self-study content built on uncontrolled data sources, (2) automated examination, assessment of learning outcomes or RANKING of learners, (3) monitoring/analysing learner behaviour via biometric or other automated means. Grace period for education systems already operating before 2026-08-15: comply by 2027-09-01. Conformity: third-party assessment for designated systems, provider self-assessment otherwise. Australia TEQSA has required ALL higher education providers to submit institutional action plans on generative-AI risks.

The base previously held APAC as "guidelines and frameworks, nothing binding". That reading is now wrong.
